text.id: Hari 7. Rabu. Gue kebangun di lantai rumah sepupu Pak Hendra, di bawah sarung yang bau minyak tanah. Sekar udah nggak ada di kasurnya.
text.en: Day 7. Wednesday. I wake on the floor of Pak Hendra's cousin's house, under a sarong that smells of kerosene. Sekar's mattress is already empty.

text.id: Dia di ujung dermaga, alat rekamnya diangkat ke arah laut. Ngerekam pagi. Kebiasaan.
text.en: She's at the end of the jetty, holding the recorder up to the sea. Recording the morning. Habit.

text.id: Syahbandar buka laut jam enam. Kapal polisi jalan dari Muara Angke jam enam lewat lima. Speedboat putih ikut di belakangnya. Satu jam lagi mereka di sini.
text.en: The harbor master opened the sea at six. The police boat left Muara Angke at five past six. A white speedboat right behind it. They'll be here in an hour.

text.id: Saya bisa bawa dia ke Tidung sekarang. Keluarga istri saya di sana. Dua jam. Mereka nggak bakal nemu.
text.en: I can take her to Tidung now. My wife's family is there. Two hours. They'll never find her.

text.id: HP Sekar ada di rumah, sama Dinda. Satu salinan rekaman Didit aman di Pluit. Yang di sini cuma alat rekamnya.
text.en: Sekar's phone is at home with Dinda. One copy of Didit's call is safe in Pluit. All that's here is the recorder.

text.id: HP Sekar ada di dasar laut, di antara patok-patok. Yang tersisa cuma alat rekam di tangan dia.
text.en: Sekar's phone is at the bottom of the sea, somewhere among the stakes. All that's left is the recorder in her hand.

text.id: Pak Hendra buka kotak seng mesinnya. HP Sekar masih di dalam plastik, kering, mati.
text.en: Pak Hendra opens the engine's tin box. Sekar's phone is still in its plastic, dry, switched off.

text.id: Lo yang pilih, Ka. Kali ini gue pengen denger lo ngomong duluan.
text.en: You choose, Ka. This time I want to hear you say it first.

text.id: Di cakrawala, dua titik. Satu abu-abu, satu putih.
text.en: On the horizon, two dots. One grey, one white.

text.id: "Pergi sama Pak Hendra. Lo harus aman."
text.en: "Go with Pak Hendra. You have to be safe."

text.id: Oke. Bareng.{w} Pak, kopi. Kita bakal kedatengan tamu.
text.en: Okay. Together.{w} Sir, coffee. We're about to have guests.
But he lights the stove anyway.

text.id: Dia nggak ngelihat gue waktu ngomong itu. Dia ngelihat dua titik di cakrawala. Satu abu-abu, satu putih.
text.en: She doesn't look at me when she says it. She looks at the two dots on the horizon. One grey, one white.
